**Q1: Which exact two “new cache schema” filenames must be added to the staged schema list (requirement #5)?**
Choices:
- **A** — You provide the exact two filenames now (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Add placeholders/TODO entries and update later when H5/H6 lands
- **C** — Skip schema-list update in this issue and handle in H5/H6 issue
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: For the changelog update, which release section should receive the H1 entry?**
Choices:
- **A** — Add under an existing `Unreleased` section (or create `Unreleased` if absent) (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Add under the latest dated/versioned release section
- **C** — Add a new dedicated H1 migration section
Reply: `Q2: A`
**Q3: For internal/template audit scope, should I touch only wrappers that correspond to the listed workflows, or audit all `internal-*.yml` and all `workflow-templates/ai-*.yml` files?**
Choices:
- **A** — Only corresponding wrappers for listed workflows (`validate`, `issue_pr_status`, `memory_maintenance`, `workflow-log-analysis`, `cancel_on_pr_close`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Audit all `internal-*.yml` and all `workflow-templates/ai-*.yml`, but edit only matching fetch-pattern files
- **C** — Audit all wrappers and normalize any similar transport pattern found, even outside listed workflow counterparts
Reply: `Q3: A`
